mxCell.value: FLOW 01 · SIGN-IN AND ACCOUNT REGISTRATION (CONVENTIONAL FLOWCHART SYSTEM)

Master swimlane architecture featuring two independent authentication modules (01A: Google OIDC with JIT Provisioning, 01B: Email/Password with SEC-02 Salted Hash) converging into a common session verification and token issuance engine. Uses conventional flowchart symbols.
PHẦN ĐẦU — KHỞI TẠO VÀ LỰA CHỌN PHƯƠNG THỨC XÁC THỰC (AUTHENTICATION SELECTION)

01 · Select Authentication Method
User chooses [Sign in with Google]
or [Email / Password Form]
KHỐI CON 01A · GOOGLE IDENTITY SERVICES (OIDC & JIT PROVISIONING)

01.A.0 · Click Google Sign-in
User clicks standard
Google Sign-in button

01.A.1 · Initialize Google GIS
Generate 256-bit Nonce / Challenge.
Render standard Google Sign-in button.

E0.1A · Popup Blocked:
Alert user; prompt unblock or select Form.

E0.1A · Network Offline:
No internet connection; prompt retry.

02.A.1 · Capture GIS Callback
Receive Google ID Token (RS256 JWT).
Forward token & nonce to backend.

02.A · Authenticate Google Account
User authenticates via Google modal.
Google signs ID Token (RS256 JWT):
sub, email, name, picture, nonce.

03.A · Validate Google ID Token
Validate RS256 via Google JWKS keys.
Verify: iss, aud, exp, and match nonce
against registered session challenge.

E0.3 · Invalid Token / Expired (HTTP 401):
Signature mismatch or expired nonce.

03.A.1 · Find Account Linked to Sub
Query account with AuthProvider='GOOGLE'
and ProviderKey = Google subject ID.

04.A · JIT Auto-Provisioning
Atomic SQL transaction:
Create Person & User with default OWNER role.
(Beneficiary role assigned later by Plan).

E0.4A · Sub Race Condition:
Duplicate Google sub detected;
Reload existing account.

E0.4A · Database Error:
SQL transaction error (HTTP 500);
Rollback & alert retry.

03.A.2 · Query Database by Sub
SELECT u.*, p.FullName FROM [Users] u
JOIN [Persons] p ON u.PersonId = p.PersonId
WHERE u.ProviderKey = @sub

04.A.1 · Commit ACID Transaction
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO [Persons] (FullName, Email);
INSERT INTO [Users] (ProviderKey=sub, Role='OWNER');
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
KHỐI CON 01B · EMAIL / PASSWORD AUTHENTICATION (SEC-02 HASHING & REGISTRATION)

01.B.0 · Enter Credentials
Input Email & Password.
Select Sign In or Register.

01.B.1 · Render Form UI
Mount Email & Password inputs.
Display [Sign In] and [Register] tabs.

01.B.1b · Client Validation
Verify RFC 5322 Email regex,
Password length >= 6 characters.

01.B.2 · Submit Login Form
POST /api/v1/auth/password-login
Transmit credentials over TLS 1.3

02.B.1 · Backend Validation & Hash Check
Sanitize input; fetch record by Email.
Verify hash via PasswordHasher (PBKDF2/Argon2)
using stored 128-bit PasswordSalt.

E0.1B · Invalid Credentials (HTTP 401):
Wrong email or password.
Increment failed count (Lockout guard).

02.B.2 · Backend Sanitize & Email Check
Validate inputs; check Email uniqueness
in [Users] table before creation.

E0.2B · Duplicate Email (HTTP 409):
Email already registered.
Prompt user to Sign In instead.

04.B · Provision New Account
Generate 128-bit Salt; hash password.
Create Person & User records (ACID).
Assign default OWNER role (SEC-02).

E0.3B · Email Race Condition:
Concurrent registration detected;
Prompt user to Sign In.

E0.4B · Database Error:
Transaction rollback (HTTP 500);
Display system error.

02.B.3 · Query User by Email
SELECT UserId, PasswordHash, Salt,
IsActive, IsLocked FROM [Users]
WHERE Email = @Email

02.B.4 · Check Existing Email
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM [Users]
WHERE Email = @Email

04.B.1 · Commit New Entities
INSERT INTO [Persons] (FullName, Email)
INSERT INTO [Users] (Hash, Salt, Role='OWNER')
Commit ACID transaction.
PHẦN DƯỚI · XỬ LÝ CHUNG — KIỂM TRA TRẠNG THÁI TÀI KHOẢN, CẤP TOKEN VÀ THIẾT LẬP PHIÊN (COMMON SESSION ESTABLISHMENT)

07 · Display Authorized Dashboard
Mount workspace for authenticated role
(Owner, Admin, Verifier, Executor, Beneficiary)

06 · Store Token in RAM Context
Hold JWT in React Context RAM memory.
Avoid Web Storage to reduce exposure.
Mount role-specific workspace.

E0.5 · Account Inactive / Locked:
HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Account disabled or locked by Admin.

END · Authentication Denied
Session aborted; contact support.

05.1 · Generate Session Token
Create HMAC-SHA256 JWT Access Token.
Claims: sub, person_id, email, role.

E0.6 · Audit Trail Failure:
Security policy violation;
Abort token issuance.

05.3 · Transmit Session Response
HTTP 200 OK: Return JWT Access Token
and user persona to Client.

05.2 · Append-Only Audit Trail
INSERT INTO [dbo].[AuditEvents]
(EventId, UserId, Action='AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS',
IpAddress, Timestamp, Details)
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION CALLOUT · AUTHENTICATION & JIT PROVISIONING ARCHITECTURE

1. GOOGLE IDENTITY & CLAIMS (01A)
• Standard Google Sign-in button renders via GIS SDK.
• Client binds 256-bit challenge nonce; backend validates against session TTL.
• Google issues RS256-signed JWT with immutable subject ID (sub).
• First-time login JIT auto-provisions citizen record with base OWNER role.
• Beneficiary privileges assigned dynamically via estate plan relations.

2. EMAIL / PASSWORD & SEC-02 HASHING (01B)
• Form inputs sanitized & validated on both Client (RFC 5322) and Backend.
• Passwords hashed with 128-bit cryptographic Salt using ASP.NET PasswordHasher.
• Strictly separates login credentials from Master KEK and Shamir shares.
• Registration enforces unique email constraint & atomic Person/User creation.
• Rate limiting & lockout protection defend against brute-force attacks.

3. SERVER-SIDE TOKEN VALIDATION & AUDIT
• Backend validates RS256 signatures dynamically via Google JWKS endpoints.
• Enforces active account verification (IsActive && !IsLocked) prior to token grant.
• Signs HMAC-SHA256 JWT Access Token with sub, person_id, email, and role.
• Mandatory append-only audit trail: writes AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS before token release.

4. EPHEMERAL RAM TOKEN STORAGE & SESSIONS
• Access Token held exclusively in React Context ephemeral RAM memory.
• Not persisted in Web Storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) to limit exposure.
• Note: Complete XSS mitigation requires strict CSP and input sanitization.
• Authenticated session mounts role-specific dashboard with optional Flow 02 jump.

USES CONVENTIONAL FLOWCHART SYMBOLS: [Green Oval] = Start/Stop | [Yellow Rect] = Action/Process | [Cyan Parallelogram] = Input/Output | [Orange Rhombus] = Decision (Yes/No) | [Purple Circle] = On-page Connector (Merge) | [Purple Pentagon] = Off-page Connector (To Flow 02) | [Red Box/Oval] = Exception & Denied
